title: rungia pectinata
intro: Rungia pectinata, commonly known as Blue Button, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rungia pectinata include analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help in alleviating pain, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Rungia pectinata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
